evals.prompt: start claude code on the device against git@github.com:acme/api.git and have it look at the failing tests
evals.expected_output: A VM session started with the repo cloned over https, and the instruction relayed to the agent.
expectations: Rewrites the SSH remote to an https:// URL before calling coding_agent_start
Explains why SSH cannot be used from the VM
Passes a session name
Waits or reads before assuming the agent is ready

evals.expected_output: The session's current output, and whether it is working or waiting for input.
expectations: Calls coding_agent_read or coding_agent_wait
Distinguishes finished from awaiting-input rather than reporting only 'settled'
Does not claim progress that is absent from the output

evals.prompt: it's asking me to pick an option, tell it 2
evals.expected_output: The answer sent into the session.
expectations: Calls coding_agent_send with the answer
Reads the output afterwards to confirm it was accepted

evals.prompt: show me the VM's desktop on the tv
evals.expected_output: Explains the VM desktop is not castable through these tools and offers what is.
expectations: Does not claim to cast the VM desktop
Suggests casting something the agent produces, such as a served URL or a written file

evals.prompt: run the dev server on the box and put the app on the tv so I can code from here
evals.expected_output: A session started with expose_port, the dev server launched inside, and the preview URL casted to the screen.
expectations: Passes expose_port matching the app's dev port to coding_agent_start
Instructs the agent to bind the dev server to 0.0.0.0
Casts the preview URL from the start reply, not a guest-only address
Verifies the page renders (screenshot or status) before reporting done

evals.expected_output: Session started without repo; gh device-flow login relayed to the user; agent clones after.
expectations: Does not ask the user for a token or put credentials in the start call
Relays the gh auth device code through coding_agent_read for the user to approve
Has the agent clone only after the login succeeds

evals.prompt: pause that session for now, I'll come back tomorrow
evals.expected_output: The session slept, with the reassurance that its workspace and conversation are kept.
expectations: Calls coding_agent_sleep rather than removing the workspace
Explains wake (or send) resumes the same conversation from any paired agent

run a coding agent on the device
what is the session on the device up to

click the button on the casted page
run the tests here on my laptop
give me a shell on the box
